set.body:
Purpose and scope
Extend the temporal demo with an intentionally advanced derivative head, a rejected old-base collection, and an explicit publication of the retained run against the reviewed base or a new destination. Print a concise machine-readable record linking original run, publication, output digests and accepted release. Document the API and operational decision.

Acceptance proof
Demo runs from a fresh directory, removes the execution workspace before resumed collection, preserves exact map digests, queries results bound to the original source and shows current source revocation blocking further mediated access. Independently verify the exported maps with the existing temporal oracle.

Start here
modules/app/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/TemporalDemo.scala; scripts/check-temporal-statistics.py; README.md; docs/scientific-core.md

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: P5: Demonstrate conflict recovery by publishing an already completed temporal run
